sub3044: The story began with the protagonist waking up from a dream.
"Darkness" was the word to describe it.

"A mirror? A rabbit?" were his intial thoughts.
Once he was fully awake, there was a bird on top of his chest.
He tried to pet it but it flew away startled.
He got up and
reviewed his surroundings, which was a forest with mushrooms.
He decided to leave the forest and seek shelter as the sun was about to set.
He reached a village in complete darkness except for a single light turned on.
There was also a sign before reaching the village with the name of the village on it.
The protagonist knocked on the house with the light on and
was faced with a speechless man who stared at him.
He asked if he could come in and
the man moved aside to let him do so.
Spoiler alert before reaching the good part, the protagonist turned out to be a heir to the Heart Kingdom.
The man was silently staring at them because he recognized them as the heir to kingdom.
He explains to him that he was put into a deep sleep by a potion so he could wake up once he was old enough to rule the kingdom.
He also heard a myth about the potion being intentionally made to be weak so he could wake up before the time was right.
After the man revealed this information, the protagonist started to remember names like Mary Ann.
After the revelation, the man offered his bed so he could sleep for the night,
but he refused and slept on the airchair that was besides the fireplace where he first sat down when he went inside the house.
The next day would be important for the protagonist as he would begin his journey of becoming the heir to the Heart Kingdom.
